{{Event infobox | location = Haiju Plains | type = group event | indicator = red boss | level = 80 | meta event = Aetherblade Assault | previous = Defeat the Aetherblade leader | coordinates = [23189.4, 100848] | requires = eod }} [[Defeat Renyak!]] is a level 80 [[Dynamic event|group event]] that occurs within the hidden [[Aetherblade Refuge]] in [[Haiju Plains]], and is the final [[boss]] event of the [[Aetherblade Assault]] [[meta event]] in [[Seitung Province]]. == Objectives == * [[Renyak, Munitions Expert]]
{{event bar}} {{event icon|boss}} * Time until Renyak wins: 10:00 == Rewards == {{Event rewards}} * One bouncy chest '''(once per day)''' ** {{rewards item|Seitung Province: Hero's Choice Chest}} ** One of the following: *** {{rewards item|Drip of Liquid Karma|chance=chance}} *** {{rewards item|Shred of Sea of Jade Mastery|chance=chance}} ** {{rewards item|Writ of Seitung Province|qty=5}} ** One of the following: *** {{rewards item|Discarded Garment|chance=chance|qty=3}} *** {{rewards item|Pieces of Unidentified Gear|chance=chance|qty=1-3}} *** {{rewards item|Piece of Rare Unidentified Gear|chance=chance}} *** [[Flame Serpent weapons]] ** {{rewards item|Bounty of Seitung Province}} ** {{rewards item|Imperial Favor|qty=20-35}} ** If the corresponding [[Specialization Collections|elite specialization collection]] is active: *** {{rewards item|Catalyst's Stamp|profession=Elementalist}} *** {{rewards item|Specter's Stamp|profession=Thief}} *** {{rewards item|Untamed's Stamp|profession=Ranger}} *** {{rewards item|Virtuoso's Authorization Papers|profession=Mesmer}} *** {{rewards item|Willbender's Authorization Papers|profession=Guardian}} ** {{rewards item|Turret Power Unit|collection=Turtle Unlock: Suiting Up}} * [[Magnificent Chest (End of Dragons)|Magnificent Chest]] * Four [[Chest (Cantha Meta)|small chests]] == Walkthrough == The bossfight area presents several environmental hazards: electrified flooring that will cause heavy damage when stood upon an active panel, spinning laser traps, that [[stun]] and cause damage, as well as shielded cannons and destructible [[Hologram Generator]]s summoning backup. [[Renyak]] himself will summon several gyros with different effects: * Bulwark Gyros, which shield him, making him immune to damage until the gyros are destroyed. * Shredder Gyros, that can be destroyed to avoid their '''Shredding Blades''' attacks. * Blast Gyros, that'll cause damage via their shockwave attack ''' Blast Detonation''' unless destroyed. In addition to the Shield Phase, in which the Bulwark Gyros have to be destroyed, Renyak is also immune to attacks during the Channeling Phase. To avoid a devastating lightning attack and continue damaging Renyak, a [[defiance bar]] has to be broken with [[CC]]. {{vendor|misc|Mastery Tutor Icebrood Saga (map icon).png|United Legions Waystation}} [[United Legions Waystation]]s providing access to {{skill icon|Electromagical Pulse 2.0}} can be useful here. Both phases are telegraphed by a visible shield bubble surrounding Renyak and announced by voicelines from the allied NPCs. == NPCs == === Allies === * [[Gwan-Soon]] * [[Tai-Young]] * [[Mr. Bots]] === Foes === * [[Blast Gyro (Renyak)|Blast Gyro]] * [[Bulwark Gyro (Renyak)|Bulwark Gyro]] * [[Holographic Pistoleer]] * [[Holographic Striker]] * [[Holographic Taskmaster]] * [[Holographic Thug]] * [[Renyak|Renyak, Munitions Expert]] * [[Shredder Gyro (Renyak)|Shredder Gyro]] == Objects == * [[Aetherblade Cannon]] * [[Hologram Generator]] == Dialogue == ;Event start{{verify|Verify order of dialogue lines}} :'''Tai-Young:''' ''What's going on here? just where are you taking our things?'' :'''Renyak, Munitions Expert:''' ''What's it to ya? Figured you wouldn't mind sharing. A little hospitality.'' :'''Gwan-Soon:''' ''More than a little. you crooks have been at it all day.'' :'''Renyak, Munitions Expert:''' ''Only what we need. But we're a needy bunch.'' :'''Mr. Bots:''' ''What exactly do you need a holo-projector for? A plow? You will return what's rightfully ours!'' :'''Renyak, Munitions Expert:''' ''You snitches take yourselves far too seriously. Should consider yanking those sticks outta your butts.'' :'''Renyak, Munitions Expert:''' ''If I gave a damn about what's "rightfully yours," I wouldn't be too good at my job, would I?'' :'''Renyak, Munitions Expert:''' ''When life doesn't give you what you need, you just gotta take it yourself. Life's not fair, so why play by its rules?'' :'''Gwan-Soon:''' ''Course it's not fair. Doesn't give you carte blanche to make it harder for other people.'' ;Imminent [[CC]] phase :'''One of the following''' :'''Gwan-Soon:''' ''Lightning! Stun him before he attacks!'' :'''Tai-Young:''' ''Gwan-Soon, watch out!'' :'''Mr. Bots:''' ''We cannot harm him this way! We must stop him from charging!'' :'''Mr. Bots:''' ''It's no use! We cannot hurt him unless we break that charge of his!'' ;Renyak is shielded :'''One of the following''' :'''Mr. Bots:''' ''Focus on the gyros! That should help us destroy his shield.'' :'''Mr. Bots:''' ''Gyros. We'll get nowhere with those shielding him. Aim for them first!'' :'''Mr. Bots:''' ''If we break those gyros, that should break his shield as well.'' ;Event success :'''Tai-Young:''' ''That's it, he's down! Keep your thieving booty out of here!'' :'''Tai-Young:''' ''Now, in accordance with legal code seven, section fourteen, I'll coordinate returning these items to their owners.'' :'''Mr. Bots''' ''I for one am going to celebrate with a good recharge and relaxing polish...'' :'''Gwan-Soon:''' ''Guess I'll begin repairs. Sooner I start, sooner my village will be back to normal.'' :'''Mr. Bots''' ''Say, Gwan-Soon. I know that Master has quite some pull over at the ministry...'' :'''Mr. Bots''' ''Perhaps I can chat with him about a relief bill. Certainly there are some spare funds lying around.'' :'''Gwan-Soon:''' ''Thank you, Mr. Bots. We would all appreciate that. You know, my friend Ae-Ri is a machinist...'' :'''Gwan-Soon:''' ''She's famous for giving bots the emperor's treatment during tune-ups. Even uses a buffer.'' :'''Mr. Bots''' ''Oh, I haven't been buffed in ages! I would love to drop by. It's about time I visited Haiju Shore.'' ;Optional dialogue if interact with Tai-Young :'''Tai-Young:''' ''Getting bills approved wouldn't be as grueling if officials weren't so divided.'' :'''Tai-Young:''' ''Some want to charge headfirst into the future of jade tech. Others are planted in the past.'' :'''Tai-Young:''' ''I think we should respect both. But not everyone sees it that way.'' ;Event failure {{Section-stub|event|Missing dialogue}} == Related achievements == * {{achievement|Eternal Seitung Province Meta-Event}} * {{achievement|Seitung Province Meta-Event}} * {{achievement|Weekly Seitung Province Jade Treasure Recovery}} * {{collection achievement|Turret Power Unit}} * {{collection achievement|Untamed's Stamp}} * {{collection achievement|Catalyst's Stamp}} * {{collection achievement|Specter's Stamp}} * {{collection achievement|Virtuoso's Authorization Papers}} * {{collection achievement|Willbender's Authorization Papers}} [[de:Bezwingt Renyak]] [[es:¡Derrota a Renyak!]] [[fr:Battez Renyak !]]
